summary: The iterative scanner handles a 15-million-character literal and passes the focused write-boundary suite. It changes the existing transformation for fragments that end with an unmatched quote: a preceding recognized pair is no longer trimmed.

findings.claim: Treating a final doubled quote as an escape without backtracking makes an unmatched trailing quote suppress trimming of an earlier single-quoted pair. The previous regex trims that pair and leaves the final quote untouched, so this regresses the export's behavior on such fragments.
